name: context-bar
description: Context card above the prompt: the window as one bar segmented by /context category (system prompt, tools, MCP, agents, memory, skills, messages, free), a legend, a fill badge coloured by threshold, plus session tokens, cost and rate limits; /context-bar for the breakdown

showBand.title: Show the context card above the prompt
showBand.description: Draw the context card above the prompt. /context-bar hide and /context-bar show change it for the session.

showLegend.title: Show the legend under the bar
showLegend.description: List each category with its tokens and share under the bar. /context-bar compact and /context-bar full change it for the session.

warnAt.title: Yellow from (% of context)
warnAt.description: The fill badge turns yellow when the context window is at least this full.

dangerAt.title: Red from (% of context)
dangerAt.description: The fill badge turns red when the context window is at least this full. Rate-limit figures use the same two thresholds.

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Show the session's cost in US dollars, as /cost totals it (on a subscription this is an API-price estimate, not a bill).
